for annotating Chinese and English at Stage 1 (numbered PropBank roles). It keeps what an annotator needs for

edit.new: UMR 0.9, abridged, for Chinese and English at Stage 1 (numbered PropBank roles), with the names of the UMR release data.

(re-entrancy: `:ARG0 s3p` above). Write the full node (name, appositive, `:part-of`) at the entity's first mention in word order, even inside a subordinate clause below the root; every later mention, also inside a relative clause, is a re-entrancy.

edit.old: Copy the numbers from the roleset's role list every time.
edit.new: Copy the numbers from the roleset's role list every time. If the roleset lists only `:ARG0`, the single participant is `:ARG0` even when it looks like a patient (it starts, ceases, is founded, appears).

edit.old: - Every Chinese predicate uses the sense and numbered roles of its own PropBank roleset.
edit.new: - Every Chinese predicate uses the sense and numbered roles of its own PropBank roleset (`:ARG1` only if the roleset has one).

edit.anchor: *but* (但是, 却, 然而, 不过) `but-91`;
edit.text: a sentence-initial connective whose first conjunct is in an earlier sentence gets no node and no modal triple (the main verb is the root);

edit.old: When a format, layout or section noun (版面, edition, section) is what is created or changed for a publication, that noun is the argument and the publication is its `:part-of`.
edit.new: When a format, layout or section noun (版面, edition, section) of a publication is an argument of any verb, that noun is the argument and the publication is its `:part-of`. Never write the inverse `:part` on the whole.

edit.old: It attaches under that object as `:ARGn-of`
edit.new: It attaches under that object (the creation verb's own argument, not its `:part-of` whole) as `:ARGn-of`

edit.old: takes that earlier event as its reference time (`:overlap` or `:after`).
edit.new: takes that earlier event as its reference time with `:overlap` (`:after` only with an explicit later-sequence word).
(the same act mentioned again, same arguments in the same roles; not a retelling with another object or agent, or a part instead of the whole).
